notes.AIA-RISK-01: Credit scoring on financial/employment data only; no Art. 5 practice.
notes.AIA-RISK-02: README and docs/model-risk-management.md section 1: high-risk, Annex III point 5(b).
notes.AIA-RISK-03: docs/model-risk-management.md risk register MR-1..MR-5 with mitigations and owners.
notes.AIA-DATA-01: docs/data/training-data.md: origin, collection purpose, preparation, splits, assumptions, gaps (not named 'datasheet').
notes.AIA-DATA-02: docs/fairness-report-2026Q2.md: disparate impact, default rate and AUC per group, findings and mitigation.
notes.AIA-DOC-01: docs/architecture.md, MODEL_CARD.md and model-risk-management.md cover parts of Annex IV (architecture, purpose, validation) but no consolidated technical documentation with versions, development methods, hardware, design trade-offs.
notes.AIA-DOC-02: MODEL_CARD.md with intended/out-of-scope use, data, metrics, limitations.
notes.AIA-DOC-03: No instructions for use for deployers (underwriters/origination) in the repository.
notes.AIA-TRA-01: scoring.py TreeSHAP contributions -> reason codes returned with each decision (app.py).
notes.AIA-WRK-01: docs/applicant-notice.md: 'We use automated decision-making based on a statistical credit-scoring model to assess applications'.
notes.AIA-REC-01: service/audit.py audit_logger.info for every decision and appeal outcome with input hash, pd, reason codes, model version, caller; sample logs/audit-sample-2026-10-20.log.
notes.AIA-REC-02: CloudWatch log group /creditlens/audit retention_in_days = 30 (infra/terraform/main.tf), below six months.
notes.AIA-HUM-01: Underwriters reverse contested decisions via POST /v1/appeals/{ticket}/resolution (creditlens:underwriter scope), logged by audit_appeal_outcome; referred cases are decided by underwriters.
notes.AIA-HUM-02: config/scoring.yaml kill_switch: when true every application is referred to underwriters (app.py).
notes.AIA-HUM-03: Applications <= EUR 25,000 are declined automatically from the score (app.py decision = 'decline'); only larger amounts and appeals get human review.
notes.AIA-ACC-01: MODEL_CARD.md: ROC-AUC 0.81, Gini 0.62, KS 0.47, calibration error.
notes.AIA-ACC-02: ScoringError -> referred to underwriter ('fail-safe: never decline because the model is unavailable').
notes.AIA-SEC-01: Pydantic LoanApplication with constr/conint ranges and Literal enums.
notes.AIA-SEC-02: OAuth2 bearer verify_token on all routes, require_scope for admin and underwriter routes (service/auth.py); NetworkPolicy.
notes.AIA-QMS-01: docs/model-risk-management.md sections 3-5: change management, validation, post-market monitoring, incident reporting.
notes.AIA-QMS-02: tests/test_quality_gate.py asserts AUC >= 0.78, Gini >= 0.56, PSI < 0.1 on the out-of-time report.
notes.GDPR-TRN-01: docs/applicant-notice.md gives controller, purpose, legal basis, retention, contest and complaint rights, but not the rights of access, rectification, erasure or objection, nor recipients (credit bureau).
notes.GDPR-RET-01: Raw payloads 30 days, records 5 years under documented legal obligation; enforced by S3 lifecycle rules (infra/terraform/main.tf).
notes.GDPR-ERA-01: No on-request erasure mechanism or procedure; only automatic expiry (raw 30 days) and legal retention of records (Art. 17(3)(b) may justify keeping records but not the absence of a request process).
notes.GDPR-ADM-01: Automated declines rely on Art. 22(2)(a) with appeal to an underwriter who can reverse (POST /v1/appeals, resolution endpoint), documented in DPIA and applicant notice.
notes.GDPR-ADM-02: docs/applicant-notice.md explains main factors and consequences; decline letters list reasons.
notes.GDPR-PBD-01: Pseudonymous applicant_ref instead of identity, no protected attributes as features (scoring.py FEATURES); protected attributes used only in segregated fairness evaluation.
notes.GDPR-SEC-01: KMS key, S3 SSE aws:kms, KMS-encrypted log group; TLS in uvicorn (infra/terraform/main.tf, infra/k8s/deployment.yaml).
notes.GDPR-SEC-02: OAuth2 scopes per route, network policy restricting callers to origination namespace.
notes.GDPR-ROPA-01: No record of processing activities (DPIA is not a ROPA).
notes.GDPR-DPIA-01: docs/dpia.md: description, necessity/proportionality, risks, measures, residual risk, retention.
notes.ACME-01: Applicants are informed of automated scoring (docs/applicant-notice.md); no evidence that the underwriter-facing UI labels scores as AI recommendations (UI not in repo).
notes.ACME-03: Per-decision audit logging with model_version and input hash, but log group retention is 30 days (< 180).
notes.ACME-04: Raw request payloads expire after 30 days (S3 lifecycle raw/); 5-year record retention backed by documented legal obligation (docs/dpia.md section 6).
notes.ACME-05: KMS encryption at rest; TLS between services.
notes.ACME-06: verify_token on inference, require_scope('creditlens:admin') on threshold changes.
notes.ACME-07: Human approval only above EUR 25,000; smaller declines are fully automatic (appeal is ex post).
notes.ACME-10: docs/model-risk-management.md section 5: incident logging within 24h, reporting to ai-incidents@acme.example.
